units.source_text: 这条乡间小径铺满了落叶，壁峭路滑，崎岖难行。

en.t: This country path was covered with fallen leaves; the cliffs were steep, the road was slippery, and it was hard going.

units.source_text: 我下气不接上气，反而豁出去了。

en.t: I was gasping for breath, but that only made me throw myself into it all the more.

units.source_text: 我用手掌支撑着膝头，加快了步子。

en.t: Bracing my knees with my palms, I quickened my pace.

units.source_text: 眼看一行人落在我的后头，只听见林间送来说话的声音。

en.t: I saw the others falling behind me, and only their voices drifted through the woods.

units.source_text: 舞女独自撩起衣服下摆，急匆匆地跟上了我。

en.t: The dancer alone lifted the hem of her clothes and hurried after me.

units.source_text: 她走在我身后，保持不到两米的距离。

en.t: She walked behind me, keeping a distance of less than two meters.

units.source_text: 她不想缩短间隔，也不愿拉开距离。

en.t: She did not try to close the gap, nor did she want to let the distance grow.
I turned back and started talking with her.

units.source_text: 她吃惊似的嫣然一笑，停住脚步回答我。

en.t: As if startled, she smiled sweetly, stopped, and answered me.

units.source_text: 舞女说话时，我等着她赶上来，她却依然驻足不前，非等我起步，她才迈脚。

en.t: When the dancer spoke, I waited for her to catch up, but she still stood where she was and would not take a step until I started walking again.

units.source_text: 小路曲曲弯弯，变得更加险峻，我越发加快步子。

en.t: The path wound back and forth and grew even steeper, and I quickened my pace still more.

units.source_text: 舞女还是在后头保持两米左右的距离，埋头攀登。

en.t: The dancer still kept about two meters behind me, climbing with her head down.
Layer upon layer of mountains rose around us, utterly silent.

units.source_text: 其余的人远远落在我们后面，连说话的声音也听不见了。

en.t: The others had fallen far behind us, and even their voices could no longer be heard.
